description: Let a group decide together with TeamSort's ranked-choice polls, where everyone puts the options in their order of preference and the favourite rises to the top. Give it a question such as where to hold the team offsite, with the choices or without them, and TeamSort writes the poll, suggests choices if you left them out, and hands back a link. Open the link to review the poll, publish it and share it with your group. Links last 7 days. No account or API key required.
